title: ranking.ready (v1)
description: RankingJudgeAgent has finished ranking candidates and frozen a RankingReport into the Research Store (see agents/ranking_judge_agent/data-contracts/ranking_report.schema.yaml). Payload is intentionally minimal: the report is read from the Research Store by ref.

ranking_report_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen RankingReport object.

candidate_kind.description: Kind of candidate that was ranked. Only 'hypothesis' is supported for now; 'benchmark' is deferred.
